voice:
In a moment I will count up from one to five, and with every number you will drift closer to the surface, keeping everything you've gained.
One. Energy beginning to return.
Two. Breathing lifting, becoming lighter.
Three. Limbs waking, gentle and light and calm.
Four. Wiggle your fingers for me... and your toes... have a good stretch — and everything you feel stays with you, because it's part of you now.
Five. Eyes open. Notice the room around you... the light, the sounds. Fully awake, fully here, feeling wonderful.
You followed every step of that count and surfaced easily — proof of how well this works for you.
Welcome back, good girl. You did perfectly.
